title.zh: 观察不出下游：差别只往下游去
title.en: Observation lies within the downstream: a difference goes only downstream

statement.zh: 一个储量之差只往它的下游去；对每个读入每个条件的律，只在储量上不同的进程在其下游之外都相同，所以储量只能经形成所读的、在储量下游的水平耦合入它，经水平耦合入是长度为零的路线；路线由闭合而形成。
statement.en: A stock's difference goes only downstream; for every law reading into each condition, courses apart only in the stock are alike off its downstream, so the stock couples into a formation only through a level it reads downstream (coupling by level: the route of length zero); routes form by closing.

laws.zh: 差别只往下游去：起始之差只在一个储量上为正、部分不给差时，在一步被传到的条件都在储量的下游，按到那一步形成的耦合；所以所携带的量，能到达的最多的差，在不在下游之处为零。链可接，形成的路线保持形成。
laws.en: A difference goes only downstream: where the starting gap is positive at one stock alone and the part gives no gap, a gap conveyed to a condition at a step lies downstream of the stock by the couplings formed by that step; so the carried amount, the most difference that can arrive, is zero wherever not downstream. Chains join, and a route formed stays formed.

laws.zh: 路线由闭合而形成：到 T + 1 形成的路线是到 T 形成的路线，与经过一个在第 T 步作用的耦合者。
laws.en: A route forms by closing: the routes formed by step T + 1 are those formed by T and those through a coupling acting at step T.

laws.zh: 读入每个条件：形成与一个条件的交换只由时程为那个条件所标的水平决定。读一个时程的律是对所有条件读得一样的特例，经耦合而读的律也是；未读入的水平耦合强度为零，所以限于所读的强度是律的强度，其路线是所读的路线。
laws.en: Reading into each condition: what a formation exchanges with a condition is fixed by the levels the schedule marks for that condition. A law reading a schedule is the case reading alike for every condition, and so is a law reading through a coupling; a level unread into a condition is coupled into it with strength zero, so the strengths restricted to what is read are strengths of the law, and their routes are routes of reading.

laws.zh: 差所到之处在下游之内：对每个读入每个条件一个时程、所读水平列出的律，两个平衡的进程在场的形成相同、部分动作相同、其余遵从律，起始只在一个储量上不同时，在每一步凡不在储量下游（按到那一步形成的所读路线）的条件都相同；所以一个形成所读入的水平都不在下游时它的交换相同，经耦合而读的律中耦合入的都不在下游时也是。经水平耦合入的储量是长度为零的路线。
laws.en: What a difference reaches lies within the downstream: for every law reading into each condition a schedule of listed levels, two balanced courses with the same formations present, the part acting alike and the rest following the law, apart at the start only in a stock, are alike at each step at every condition not downstream of the stock by the readings formed by then; so a formation whose readings into a condition all lie off the downstream exchanges alike, and so does one, under a law reading through the couplings, all of whose couplings lie off it. The stock coupled in by level is the route of length zero.

laws.zh: 量度的见证：一个形成从第 T 步起把储量的水平加到记录上，在记录显示至少 N 时从储量汲取。T 之前储量下游只有它自己，没有经过它的回路；在第 T 步从储量到记录的路线与储量 → 记录 → 汲取的回路形成；只在储量上不同的两个进程，记录到 T 为止相同，跨过第 T 步差出抬高，汲取回应记录。
laws.en: The measurement witness: from step T a formation adds the stock's level to a record, and draws from the stock while the record shows at least N. Before T only the stock lies downstream of it and no loop passes through it; at T the route stock → record and the loop stock → record → draw form; in two courses apart only on the stock the record is alike up to T and differs by the raise across the step from T, and the draw responds to the record.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。各定理所写者写在定理中：律读入每个条件的时程（ReadsInto），所读的水平列出；起始之差只在储量上，部分不给差（对所携带的量）；两个进程平衡、在场的形成相同、部分动作相同、其余遵从律，起始只在储量上不同（对进程）。不判定条件，不需条件有限。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. What each theorem needs is written into it: the schedule a law reads into each condition (ReadsInto), the levels read being listed; the starting gap at the stock alone and none from the part (for the carried amount); two balanced courses with the same formations present, the part acting alike and the rest following the law, apart at the start only in the stock (for the courses). No decision on conditions, and no finiteness of conditions, is used.

does_not_show.zh: 在下游者必不同：一个形成可以读而不回应；见证给出实际不同的一例。
does_not_show.en: That what lies downstream differs: a formation may read without responding; the witness gives one case where it does.

does_not_show.zh: 律读什么、量度何时开始、记录是否及时被读；带误差的量度。
does_not_show.en: Which schedule a law reads, when a measurement starts and whether the record is read in time; measurement with error.

does_not_show.zh: 以强度陈述进程：由强度界多处不同的历史之差要逐处换历史，需判定条件；这里进程的定理用读的时程。
does_not_show.en: Statements on courses by strengths: bounding a difference of histories apart in many places by strengths changes them one place at a time and needs a decision on conditions; the theorems on courses here use the schedule read.

next_delta.zh: 带误差的量度；他者的读作为路线；在下游者何时必不同（回应的下界）；obs 能由依赖推出这一猜想；独立审查。
next_delta.en: Measurement with error; another's reading as a route; when what lies downstream must differ (lower bounds on responses); the conjecture that obs could be derived from dependence; an independent review.

correspondence.zh: P124 留下“一个形成怎样开始观察它所依赖的储量”；Ren 对 P124 的做法答“approve your approach, please continue”。本结果部分回答：一个形成只能在从所观察者出发的所读路线的末端观察；反方向（在下游者必造成差别）不成立。这一必要性是一种无干扰性质（Goguen 与 Meseguer 1982）：不在储量下游者不受它影响，如信息流的依存图读法。读法（AI 的，减弱为 apart_only_downstream 所表明的，Ren 2026-10-18 取，DELEGATED-CHOICES D43）：观察在下游之内：一个形成的交换只经它所读、位于储量下游的水平回应储量上的差别，直接观察是长度为零的路线，量度、模型或他者的读是更长的路线；一个形成开始观察，是一次读闭合一条路线；P124 第二项读法中断裂之前对储量水平的读就是这样一条路线。在 obs 能由依赖推出的意义上，观察不是依赖之外的第二种关系，超出定理：定理只表明观察不越出依赖，未表明观察就是依赖；它作为猜想保留，不是读法。在 obs 与依赖都是耦合（经水平与经阈）的意义上，它成立（where-a-level-couples，以其在一个说明中的位置采用，DELEGATED-CHOICES D45）。
correspondence.en: P124 left open how a formation comes to observe a stock it depends on; Ren answered P124's approach with “approve your approach, please continue”. This result answers in part: a formation can observe only at the end of a route of readings from what is observed; the converse, that what lies downstream makes a difference, fails. That necessity is a noninterference property (Goguen and Meseguer 1982): what is not downstream of the stock is unaffected by it, as in the dependency-graph reading of information flow. Readings (the AI's, weakened to what apart_only_downstream shows and taken by Ren on 18 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D43): observing lies within the downstream: a formation's exchange responds to a difference at a stock only through a level it reads that lies downstream of the stock, direct observation being the route of length zero and a measurement, a model or another's reading a longer route; a formation comes to observe by a reading that closes a route; the reading of the stock's level before the break in P124's second reading is such a route. That observation is not a second relation beside dependence, in the sense that obs could be derived from dependence, goes beyond the theorem, which shows only that observation does not go beyond dependence, not that it is dependence; it is kept as a conjecture, not a reading. In the sense that obs and dependence are both coupling, by level and by threshold, it holds (where-a-level-couples, adopted by its place in one account, DELEGATED-CHOICES D45).

history.en: 16 October 2026, eighteenth review (R18): the title and law 3 claimed identity (“Observation is a route”, “Registering is being downstream”), while apart_only_downstream proves necessity only: what is not downstream stands alike; the converse fails, as does_not_show 0 concedes (review item 26, O5). The title now reads “Observation lies within the downstream”, the statement “can register it only through”, law 3 “Registering lies within the downstream”, and the correspondence answers in part and says the converse fails; the reading “observation is not a second relation beside dependence” gains the note that the theorem shows only that observation does not go beyond dependence, the reading itself being Ren's to keep, weaken or drop (item 45). The correspondence names Goguen–Meseguer 1982 (item 39, K7). The record id is unchanged. Claim narrowed; no theorem changed.
